findings.reason: Added an exact coefficientwise check of the returned phase list against its completed polynomial pair before QSVT execution. The assigned degree theorem now proves the peel and convention-conversion steps reconstruct that pair; mismatches return PHASE_PRODUCT_ERROR.
Required clean B-preparation work, specified the good-or-unfinished projector and included B work in the final zero test. The stopping proof now uses these exact workspace and projector conventions.

Specified a Hermitian finite-precision matrix, the exact h=1 QA25 encoding and its local compression argument, QSVT block-error budgets, and a per-call Duhamel/hybrid sum for QPE and Fourier simulations. The stopping proof propagates these errors.

Separated the sparse/input-preparation query result from the gate result and stated uniform per-call gate bounds for preparation, sparse access, controlled/inverse operations, simulation, phase compilation, reflections, predicates and instruments. This matches the access and gate-efficiency model in the [primary CKS paper](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1511.02306); classical bit costs remain separate.
